title: DeepSTARR enhancer activity
description: Predict the activity of 249 bp enhancer sequences in Drosophila S2 cells, for a developmental and a housekeeping promoter.

title: Gosai MPRA activity
dataset: Gosai et al. 2024 episomal MPRA: K562, HepG2, SK-N-SH
metric_label: Test Pearson r (mean of 3 cell types)
description: Predict the activity of 200 bp sequences in an episomal massively parallel reporter assay, as log2 fold change in K562, HepG2 and SK-N-SH cells.

title: K562 ATAC-seq profiles
task: Profile and count prediction from 2,114 bp of DNA
metric_label: Validation score (mean of profile Pearson r, count R² and pooled count R²)
description: Predict base-resolution ATAC-seq profiles and total counts in K562 cells from 2,114 bp of DNA, with the peaks, non-peaks and chromosome split of ChromBPNet fold 0.
note: Ranked on validation data, which each search also used to choose its models.

title: K562 PRO-cap profiles
task: Profile and count prediction from 2,114 bp of DNA
metric_label: Validation score (mean of profile Pearson r and count R²)
description: Predict base-resolution PRO-cap profiles on both strands and total counts in K562 cells from 2,114 bp of DNA, with the data and chromosome split of ProCapNet fold 1.
note: Ranked on validation data, which each search also used to choose its models.

title: PARM promoter MPRA, K562
dataset: PARM promoter MPRA, library v2_MH4, K562
task: Regression from DNA fragments of 93 to 600 bp
description: Predict the promoter activity of MPRA fragments in K562 cells, as log2 of reporter RNA over plasmid DNA, with the folds deposited by the PARM authors.
note: Ranked on validation data, which each search also used to choose its models.

title: HumanBrainDev cell-state accessibility
task: Accessibility per cell state from 524,288 bp of DNA
description: Predict chromatin accessibility at 32 bp resolution in each cell state of the developing human cortex, from 524,288 bp of DNA and a cell-state embedding.
note: Ranked on validation data, which each search also used to choose its models.
